name: restore-terminal-enter-submit
title: Restore Enter submit in the app terminal input
description: TextInputAction.none was set on the app terminal input field to keep the soft keyboard open after Return, but it also disables Return as a submit action, so onSubmitted never fires and commands cannot be sent. Restore TextInputAction.send and rely on the existing refocus/TextInput.show path to keep the keyboard up. Regression introduced in b75f656.
creator: lichengyu
